limits: Only newly generated history receives resolved IDs; old missing-ID histories are not rebuilt or migrated and may still change identity on redo.
Coverage is the named operations and stacks, not every supported combination.
Existing null versus empty-array representations for empty tracks remain unchanged; test baseline normalizes that empty collection only.

Historical prevention of explicit-ID reuse for new objects after deletion is not implemented: idSet checks live objects. This separate gap is recorded in the plan, without weakening the no-reuse requirement.
No new native Wails window, process-kill/power-loss, device/physical audio, real-model or dense-page performance acceptance.
developmentFindings: Initial IPC/browser baseline compared blank tracks null against post-undo empty array; corrected only test normalization, no production shape changes.
IPC snapshots initially shared slice backing arrays because JSON decoded into a reused Project; corrected test to decode each response into a fresh Project.
